visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a blue and white checkered shirt and a black beanie stands in an indoor retail space, mimicking the pose of a celebrity on a large promotional poster behind him. He smiles broadly and waves. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene transitions to a promotional stage event with a blue backdrop featuring star patterns and brand logos. The man in the checkered shirt is now acting as a host, holding a microphone and a pink cue card. He stands next to a celebrity dressed in a light blue suit who is also speaking into a microphone. (3) Visuals show close-ups of product gift sets and a dense crowd of onlookers in a shopping mall hallway, many of whom are holding up smartphones to record. The editing involves fast cuts between the stage and the audience. (4) On stage, the celebrity interacts with fans, including brushing a toddler's hair and applying hair cream to a young woman's hair. The host reacts with comedic, high-energy facial expressions and gestures. (5) The video ends with the host standing alone in front of the event backdrop, gesturing towards the camera as if inviting a response from viewers.
